role: Catalog repo: 15 named silent-failure modes together with a validation harness; the catalog itself is the deliverable.
what_it_is: 15 named silent-failure modes - validation that passes while nothing is being checked. Each with a runnable reproduction, a fixing recipe and a negative control, plus a self-testing linter.
what_it_is_not: Not a running commercial service. Not a third-party certification, compliance finding, or regulatory approval.
reproduce: See the README section "运行测试 / Running the tests"; commands are verbatim and require no private network.
evidence_state: Outsider-view probe recorded 2026-11-22 (anonymous, no token); see this repository README and docs.
claims_policy: No first-in-class, greenfield, or only-implementation claims. Each comparison states its own boundary.
